costs.scope: Separate fresh main-invocation timers include inline verification and prior writes. Preparation and search subtotals are nested, not additive. Qualification is not a cold benchmark against an ATP.

limitations: This gate qualifies these complete tiny traces under the unchanged indexed point engine; the earlier legacy graph-checker rejection is retained and historical sampled runs are not retroactively verified.

The checker assumes an externally qualified complete immutable universe. Here the abstract inventories are explicit and exhaustively subset-checked; native factory, full row construction, failure certificates and logical proof checks are separately joined.

This is an anchored symbolic proof-tree point profile with literal formula colors and global mark-only ports, not a fixed translation-only Wang square-grid palette or a universal first-order proof encoding.

Native targets are fresh synthetic ground Horn and vacuous-generalization examples. No new Peano-arithmetic or Hilbert-geometry benchmark, RL training, ATP advantage, Turtle substitution, Penrose or plane-tiling result is established.

Rollback logical states are independently reconstructed; internal trail indices are checked arithmetically, not instruction-by-instruction. Ordering traces must be complete permutations, but arbitrary future learned policies and macro expansions require their own admission audit.
UNSAT here means exhaustion of the declared finite inventory and address bound. Neither bounded absence nor an interrupted search proves unrestricted logical nonprovability.
